title: P0: app-layer demolish dispatch (select -> popover/X-DEL -> Cmd_Demolish_*) has zero automated coverage; demos bypass the app package entirely
detail: The story's load-bearing claim is that the surface drives the real commands, yet the harness imports only ../core and ../app/render — the app package is never linked. The two new demos lower demolish intents straight into core, so nothing ever exercises click_select, popover_click, or this proc.
recommended_fix: Add app-layer tests driving the dispatch: click_select -> popover button/X-DEL -> demolish_pipe/demolish_node asserting the appended Cmd_Demolish_* and selection clear. Extract the swallow/select logic into testable procs.

title: P0: reject toast error paths (Missing_Pipe / Terminal_Demolish via the UI) have no negative tests
evidence:
app/main.odin:697-700:
"	} else {
		app.last_reject = err
		app.reject_tick = app.tick
	}"
app/main.odin:1135 (diff):
"case .Terminal_Demolish: return \"can't demolish a terminal\" // 5.5 (UI never offers it — core belt-and-braces)"
core/demolish_test.odin:42,151:
"test_demolish_terminal_rejected :: proc(t: ^testing.T) {"
"test_demolish_missing_targets_rejected :: proc(t: ^testing.T) {"
detail: Core reject semantics are tested (settled, locked), but the new app wiring — error -> last_reject toast, selection kept on failure — is untested. No test submits a demolish for a missing pipe or terminal through the app procs.
recommended_fix: Add negative app-layer tests: demolish_pipe with a missing id asserts last_reject == .Missing_Pipe and sel_pipe unchanged; demolish_node on a terminal asserts the .Terminal_Demolish toast path.

title: P1: new input paths (click_select, popover_click, release_ui_hit, X/DEL keys) have 0% test coverage
detail: No test anywhere references click_select, popover_click, release_ui_hit, or the X/DEL dispatch. Selection priority (junction -> pipe -> clear), terminal-click-clears (AC3), popover swallow, and release_ui_hit boundary are code-reading-only.
recommended_fix: Headless-test the selection procs: junction/pipe/terminal/empty priority, popover button-vs-panel swallow, release_ui_hit over popover and tray rects, X/DEL dispatch and its placing/mid-drag inertness.

title: P2: press_swallowed lifecycle, ESC deselect, and selection-after-junction-batch have no boundary tests
evidence:
app/main.odin:331-337:
"app.press_swallowed = true // the cancel gesture's release must not re-select"
"app.sel_pipe = -1
		app.sel_node = -1
		app.press_swallowed = true // an in-flight click's release must not re-select after ESC"
app/main.odin:370,404:
"app.press_swallowed = false    // reset until a popover/tray click consumes the press"
"app.press_swallowed = true"
detail: The swallow latch has five setters (popover, tray, ESC, placement-cancel, drag-interrupt) and one reset, gating both click-select and the placement commit; a wrong set/reset silently breaks selection or places routers. No test covers any transition.
recommended_fix: Test the latch lifecycle: tray/popover press then release must not re-select or place; ESC then release must not re-select; junction batch must clear both selections.

title: P3: byte-identical goldens gate exists (CI + local harness) but CI is billing-blocked, so the 22/22 claim rests on a local run
evidence:
.github/workflows/ci.yml:
"- name: Golden harness (T1 hashes + T2 software pixels + replay gate)
        run: tools/harness.sh run"
_pr_body.md (diff):
"- CI note: GitHub Actions billing is blocked at the account level — the PR's
  CI will be red/not-started until fixed; NOT a code failure. Full local suite
  is green."
detail: A gate exists and is claimed green locally, but no automated evidence accompanies the PR. Existing goldens MUST not shift; until billing is fixed the claim is unverifiable by the PR's own infrastructure.
recommended_fix: Attach harness run output to the PR body or re-enable CI billing so the golden harness + drift-check gates execute on the PR.

title: Advisory test gate: FAIL
evidence: grep "@(test)" app/ — no test procs exist in the app layer (only a comment in app/render/forecast.odin:123); grep for click_select/popover_click/release_ui_hit/press_swallowed/sel_node across *_test.odin — zero references; "total @(test) procs in core: 153"; diff adds 18 files, none *_test.odin.
detail: P0 coverage 0% (no test drives the surface dispatch or its reject toasts); P1 coverage 0% (input paths, X/DEL gating); overall new-code coverage ~0%. The 2 new demos re-verify the locked core path, not the new app code.
recommended_fix: Add app-layer headless tests (selection, swallow, dispatch, toasts, latch lifecycle) and a CI step that runs them with the harness.
